Priced charging offers with exact terms
Request priced charging offers for one port and night\x3C!-- --> \x3Cspan class=\"font-mono font-medium text-blue-600 dark:text-blue-400 ms-auto text-xs text-nowrap\">POST\x3C/span>
Creates the driver session cookie if absent. Each offer carries exact terms and their SHA-256 `termsHash`, which accept must echo.
Accepting an offer and the PayPal approval round trip
Accept one exact, unexpired offer and create the PayPal authorize order\x3C!-- --> \x3Cspan class=\"font-mono font-medium text-blue-600 dark:text-blue-400 ms-auto text-xs text-nowrap\">POST\x3C/span>

Requires the driver's explicit consent (`consent: true`) and the `termsHash` the driver saw; tampered or expired\nterms are refused. Returns the PayPal approval link. Nothing is authorized or charged until the buyer approves in PayPal.\n
